results.question: 各门店销售额排名
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 华东区近30天销售额最高的门店是哪个
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.region = '华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 各区域销售额占比
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, ROUND(SUM(o.amount)*100.0 / SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER (), 2) as sales_share FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, ROUND((SUM(o.amount)*100.0 / SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER ())::numeric, 2) as sales_share FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 分析华东区最近销售情况
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region='华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) as date, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM orders o JOIN store s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE s.region='华东' AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY date

results.question: 对比华东和华北两个区域的销售表现
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id),0),2) as refund_rate FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC
SELECT s.region, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as store_count FROM store s WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region

results.question: 分析各区域销售额的同比变化
sqls: SELECT MIN(create_time) AS min_time, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM orders

SELECT s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) AS year, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) ORDER BY s.region, year

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) AS year, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales
  FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time)
)
SELECT region,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN sales END),0) AS sales_2025,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year=2026 THEN sales END),0) AS sales_2026,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN year=2026 THEN sales END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN sales END))*100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year=2025 THEN sales END),0), 2) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM yearly
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
